attributes.PROJECTDESCRIPTION: EMERGENCY TREE REMOVAL REQUEST - LIGHTNING STRIKE - ONE TREE IMPACTED. On 07-16-26 at approx 10:30 AM, one of our doug fir trees was hit by lightning. The power surge was so intense it traveled to the ground, blowing off the bark and damaging the tree. Due to the tree appearing actively smoking, we called Bellevue Fire Dept for emergency fire assessment (case #26-12679). Today 07-17, an arborist from Blooma Tree Experts (#LIC-TSP-18504) came an inspected the tree and decided that sadly it needs to be removed for safety, as it is almost 80 ft tall and now unstable, can fall on our or our neighbors home during the next big windstorm. Weather experts have been saying this Fall 2026 is expected to be very blustery and while we hate to cut down any of our trees, we are concerned for everyone's safety. Our property has a total of 13 trees, we are only removing the one injured sick tree, which leaves 12 trees surviving (and hopefully thriving) on the property.

The total estimated cut and fill quantity is approximately 10,100-CY.  The cut and fill activities will balance each other out with no import or export of soils anticipated.  There will be no work below the ordinary high water mark.  All work activities and soil disturbance will be done outside of all wetland and stream buffers.
